text: Norway's $2.3T sovereign wealth fund recorded a Q3 loss of 278B kroner ($29.7B). Fixed income returned -3.5%, while equities gained 0.5%. Bonds comprise just over 25% of assets, with 70% of fixed income allocated to sovereign debts. Energy equities outperformed utilities and real estate.

meta.note: Asset-class returns differ; the reported portfolio loss is an aggregate accounting measure.
